maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (INC-5423) focused on recurring KV-cache evictions. Need: a short, no-nonsense playbook entry, exact evidence-capture cmds, escalation matrix that maps pattern -> PD level, and a maintenance cadence for the playbook. Please claim pieces and ETA.
rory: I'll own the playbook edit and compact checklist. ETA: 2026-04-07. I'll keep it under one screen for on-call.
izzy: I'll add the evidence-capture script and a small jq wrapper to normalize outputs for tickets. ETA: 2026-04-06.
sam: I'll own wiring the alert -> ticket automation and PD routing rules. Suggest: auto-create ticket when eviction_signature_count >= 3 in 24h; escalate to Sev2 (pager) if p99 delta > 150ms for 10m. ETA: 2026-04-08.
ops-bot: Created INF-8201 and linked to postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-8201 (playbook + automation + maintenance cadence)
diego: I'll take the maintenance cadence and OWNERS update. Proposal: 60-day rotation with a 7-day pre-handoff notice. ETA: 2026-04-10.
maya: Good. Rory - please include expected outputs (sample evict response, metric delta) so the on-call can verify quickly. Izzy - include a one-liner to attach to tickets. Sam - ensure ticket template contains owner, ETA, and playbook link.
rory: Draft checklist (one-screen):
- step 1: confirm signature: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | egrep -i "KVCache|evict"`
- step 2: snapshot metrics: `kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- curl -sS localhost:9090/metrics | egrep "kv_cache_entries|inference_service_p99"`
- step 3: safe-evict (staging first): `kubectl -n inference exec -it $POD -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9090/debug/cache/evict"`
- step 4: post-check: wait 5m, assert 5xx < 1% and cpu < 85% -> if not, rollback and page infra lead.

rory: I'll add a two-line example output: `{"status":"ok","evicted":120}` and note that kv_cache_entries should fall >= 10%.

izzy: Evidence capture helper (one-liner to paste into ticket):
```bash
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') && kubectl -n inference logs $POD --since=30m | egrep -i 'evict|KVCache' > /tmp/evict.log && kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- curl -sS localhost:9090/metrics | egrep 'kv_cache_entries|inference_service_p99' > /tmp/metrics.txt && jq -n --rawfile L /tmp/evict.log '{logs:$L}'
```
izzy: That produces an attachable JSON blob for tickets. I'll add a tiny script in runbooks/tools/evict-collect.sh.
sam: Alert pseudo-rule I'll implement in Datadog:
- trigger: sum(last_24h:eviction_signature{service:inference}) >= 3 OR increase(inference_service_p99_ms[10m]) > 150
- action: create INF-8201 ticket with template fields (owner, ETA:48h, playbook link, recent-logs link). If p99 delta condition hits, mark as Sev2 and page via PagerDuty routing to `infra-oncall`.

ops-bot: INF-8201 updated: subtasks created - INF-8201-1 (playbook edit) -> rory; INF-8201-2 (evidence script) -> izzy; INF-8201-3 (alert wiring) -> sam; INF-8201-4 (owners rotation) -> diego.
diego: OWNERS plan: add `kv-playbook` rotation with 4 names, 60-day cadence, ops-bot will post a pre-handoff message 7 days prior and create a calendar block for quarterly drills. I'll update OWNERS and the runbooks README.

rory: PR opened: https://git.redwood/runbooks/pull/642  compact playbook + expected outputs + rollback bullets.
izzy: Script committed: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/1a2b3c  evict-collect.sh added and example ticket output included.
sam: Datadog rule stubbed and test alert created; test ticket auto-created and properly populated with fields. I'll route to PD test channel for confirmation.
(48h)
rory: PR merged after minor nits: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/3d4e5f  playbook live and linked from postmortem. Marking INF-8201-1 done.
izzy: Script smoke-tested in staging: evict returned {"status":"ok","evicted":98}, metrics show kv_cache_entries drop ~11%, no 5xx spike in 10m. Attached validation notes to the commit.
sam: Alert live in staging and test ticket flow validated. Will promote to prod after 72h of quiet.
diego: OWNERS file updated and first rotation scheduled. Ops-bot pre-handoff notice set to send on 2026-04-03.
maya: Solid. Next items: 1) monitor alert for noise for 7 days, 2) run the first drill in staging and post-run notes, 3) ensure ticket ownership + ETA are consistently filled by automation. If anything needs more time, call it out.
rory: I'll run the drill during the next maintenance window and post notes.
izzy: Leaving one small follow-up: add a short FAQ when evict fails with 500 (capture core dump + escalate to infra lead). I'll add a tiny patch.
sam: Pushing prod alert after quiet window.
ops-bot: INF-8201 status: in-progress -> monitoring.
maya: Closing loop here for now. Thanks team  please paste any supplementary links into INF-8201 and tag them `postmortem-followup`. :white_check_mark:
